steps.name: 1-boot
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({path: location.pathname, nestUI: typeof NestUI, version: window.NestUI && NestUI.version, dark: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'), themeBtns: document.querySelectorAll('[data-nx-theme-toggle]').length, metaTheme: (document.querySelector('meta[name=theme-color]') || {}).content || null, progress: !!document.querySelector('.nx-progress-top'), chip: !!document.querySelector('.nx-cmdk-chip')})

steps.name: 2-theme-toggle
steps.eval: (function(){ var b = document.querySelector('[data-nx-theme-toggle]'); if (!b) return 'no-toggle'; var was = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'); b.click(); return JSON.stringify({was: was, now: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'), stored: localStorage.getItem('nest-theme'), meta: (document.querySelector('meta[name=theme-color]') || {}).content || null, vt: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-vt'), scheme: document.documentElement.style.colorScheme, bodyBg: getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor}); })()

steps.name: 3-theme-restore
steps.eval: (function(){ var b = document.querySelector('[data-nx-theme-toggle]'); if (b) b.click(); return JSON.stringify({dark: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'), stored: localStorage.getItem('nest-theme')}); })()

steps.name: 4-palette-open
steps.eval: (function(){ document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true})); return 'sent'; })()

steps.name: 5-palette-shape
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({open: !!(document.querySelector('.nx-cmdk') && document.querySelector('.nx-cmdk').classList.contains('is-open')), items: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-cmdk-item').length, groups: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-cmdk-group').length, bodyLocked: document.body.classList.contains('nx-noscroll'), hasInput: !!document.querySelector('.nx-cmdk input')})

steps.name: 6-palette-filter
steps.eval: (function(){ var i = document.querySelector('.nx-cmdk input'); if (!i) return 'no-input'; var before = document.querySelectorAll('.nx-cmdk-item').length; i.value = 'dark'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return JSON.stringify({before: before, after: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-cmdk-item').length, first: (document.querySelector('.nx-cmdk-item') || {}).textContent}); })()

steps.name: 9-toast
steps.eval: (function(){ NestUI.toast('交互层自测：这是一条提示', 'ok', 4000); return JSON.stringify({stack: !!document.querySelector('.nx-toast-stack'), toasts: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-toast').length, text: (document.querySelector('.nx-toast-text') || {}).textContent}); })()

steps.name: 10-copy-fallback
steps.eval: (async function(){ var ok = await NestUI.copy('copy-probe-123'); return JSON.stringify({returned: ok, clipboardApi: typeof navigator.clipboard, toasts: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-toast').length, lastText: (Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.nx-toast-text')).pop() || {}).textContent}); })()

steps.name: 11-ripple
steps.eval: (function(){ var t = document.querySelector('.nx-btn, .nx-tab, .nx-icon-btn'); if (!t) return 'no-target'; t.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {bubbles: true, button: 0, clientX: 10, clientY: 10})); return JSON.stringify({hosts: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-ripple-host').length, ripples: document.querySelectorAll('.nx-ripple').length, tag: t.tagName, cls: t.className.slice(0, 40)}); })()

steps.name: 13-elevate-state
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({elevated: document.querySelectorAll('[data-nx-scrolled="1"]').length, progressWidth: (document.querySelector('.nx-progress-top') || {}).offsetWidth || 0, pageWidth: window.innerWidth, scrollY: Math.round(window.scrollY)})

steps.name: 14-tour
steps.eval: (function(){ return JSON.stringify({nestTour: typeof NestTour, driver: typeof window.driver, startFn: typeof window.NestTour && typeof NestTour.start, popovers: document.querySelectorAll('.driver-popover').length, tourFlag: localStorage.getItem('nest-tour-done') || localStorage.getItem('nest-tour-seen')}); })()
